title.value: MII VS Microbiology LOINC Ontology General Microscopy Finding In Specimen

description.value: Proposal: LOINC codes of the microbiology request 'Microscopy: General microscopy — method-neutral 'finding in specimen' pattern', computed by ECL over the LOINC Ontology 2026-10-21. The technique-free pattern of 105059-0: nominal Presence or identity that inheres in the specimen itself (no organism, no technique). Catches the method-neutral microscopy codes that the technique filter misses. Parts: LOINC enumeration (357, LOINC 2.83), LOINC Ontology observables without LOINC code (0), and the ECL as an intensional include.
